pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: India's power trade with neighbours (no key)
wrong topic: current affairs (UN Internet Governance Forum)

patterns: Dominant shape: 'Which is NOT a member' (Myanmar not SAARC, China not ASEAN, Iran not GCC) and founding year/place (SAARC Charter, Dhaka 1985).
APPSC asks summit venues as current affairs: 6th BIMSTEC Summit Bangkok 2025, SCO 2022 Samarkand (Uzbekistan), 15th ASEAN Summit Thailand.
UPSC-style items probe BIMSTEC founding/centres and EU instruments (Digital Single Market, Stability and Growth Pact).
Newest-member traps recur: Croatia in EU (2013), Finland/Sweden in NATO.
App matches the shapes well but leans to multi-statement items on agreements (BBIN, AIFTA/AITIGA) where APPSC uses one-line venue/year questions.
